units: <cite ref="Yevamot 121b:1">Yeb. 121ᵇ</cite> top, <he>אגב איצצא מזקי</he> (Ar. <cite ref="A01573"><he>איצא</he></cite>) on account of the pressure (which the falling person exercises on the serpents in the pit) they injure him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 144b:11">Sabb. 144ᵇ</cite> <he>דאתי בתר איצצא</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A01574"><he>איצצתא</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>אִיצִיצָא</he>) (the juice) which oozes out of the grapes through the pressure of their non weight.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:17">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite> salted fish made fit for immediate use <he>אגב א׳</he> by squeezing (and washing) out the salt.—Pl. <he>אִיצְצֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>שיתין א׳</he> sixty times pressed and washed.

senses.gloss: trnsf. depression, depreciation in the market; [oth. opin. deterioration of quality].
units: Keth. 100ᵇ אע״ג דנפל ביה איצצתא (read דנפלא; Ar. דהוי ביה איצא, Rashi איצצא) though there is a risk of depreciation (on account of large supply for the festive season) [or of getting sour].
